headline: Gabon: Eramet launches capital increase of nearly 500 million €
summary: Eramet has launched a capital increase of nearly €500 million, according to Financial Afrik's report on Gabon.
why: Eramet is a French mining and metals group with manganese and nickel operations in Gabon and New Caledonia, so its capital raising affects funding for its mining projects.
original_headline: Gabon : Eramet lance une augmentation de capital de près de 500 millions €
